title: The interaction of InvF-RNAP is mediated by the chaperone SicA in Salmonella sp: an in silico prediction.
authors: Farias, Andre B; Cortes-Avalos, Daniel; Ibarra, J Antonio; Perez-Rueda, Ernesto
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和丙氨酸扫描预测沙门氏菌转录因子InvF与RNAP及伴侣SicA的互作，虽涉及TF-DNA结合域稳定性，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合位点或界面建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: In this work we carried out an in silico analysis to understand the interaction between InvF-SicA and RNAP in the bacterium Salmonella Typhimurium strain LT2. Structural analysis of InvF allowed the identification of three possible potential cavities for interaction with SicA. This interaction could occur with the structural motif known as tetratricopeptide repeat (TPR) 1 and 2 in the two cavities located in the interface of the InvF and alpha-CTD of RNAP. Indeed, molecular dynamics simulations showed that SicA stabilizes the Helix-turn-Helix DNA-binding motifs, i.e., maintaining their proper conformation, mainly in the DNA Binding Domain (DBD). Finally, to evaluate the role of amino acids that contribute to protein-protein affinity, an alanine scanning mutagenesis approach, indicated that R177 and R181, located in the DBD motif, caused the greatest changes in binding affinity with alpha-CTD, suggesting a central role in the stabilization of the complex. However, it seems that the N-terminal region also plays a key role in the protein-protein interaction, especially the amino acid R40, since we observed conformational flexibility in this region allowing it to interact with interface residues. We consider that this analysis opens the possibility to validate experimentally the amino acids involved in protein-protein interactions and explore other regulatory complexes where chaperones are involved.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们进行了计算机模拟分析，以理解沙门氏菌鼠伤寒血清型LT2菌株中InvF-SicA与RNAP之间的相互作用。对InvF的结构分析识别出三个可能的潜在空腔，用于与SicA相互作用。这种相互作用可能发生在位于InvF与RNAP的α-CTD界面上的两个空腔中，涉及被称为四肽重复序列（tetratricopeptide repeat, TPR）1和2的结构基序。确实，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，SicA稳定了螺旋-转角-螺旋DNA结合基序，即维持其正确构象，主要是在DNA结合域（DNA Binding Domain, DBD）中。最后，为评估对蛋白质-蛋白质亲和力有贡献的氨基酸作用，采用丙氨酸扫描诱变方法，结果表明位于DBD基序中的R177和R181对与α-CTD的结合亲和力变化影响最大，提示它们在复合物稳定化中起核心作用。然而，N端区域似乎在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中也扮演关键角色，尤其是氨基酸R40，因为我们观察到该区域的构象灵活性使其能够与界面残基相互作用。我们认为，这一分析为实验验证参与蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的氨基酸，并探索涉及伴侣蛋白的其他调控复合物提供了可能性。
